name: brainDump
about: Internal variables of B7 epoch 6 run over one song (scripts/brain/braindump.py). A data export; it licenses no sentence. Mechanism names only.

files.<song>.braindump.npz: compressed numpy archive, the arrays below
files.<song>.braindump.json: the shapes, counts, thresholds, checkpoint and its sha256

timebase.sample_k_is_song_frame: (10 k) // 3 at 100 Hz, time k / 30 s
timebase.block_lanes: gain and exponent hold the value of the 2 s block (200 frames) the sample frame lies in
timebase.coherence_grid: 10 Hz, own axis: window m covers frames [10 m, 10 m + 100) and ends at time (m + 10) / 10 s

modes.meaning: complex state h of the 256 modes of layers L1..L4, last axis [Re, Im]

pred_mean.meaning: each layer's predicted mean of the 44 standardised features for the window [t + h, t + 2h), made at the sample frame; h = 10, 50, 200, 800 frames

target.meaning: the actual mean of the features over that window, stamped on the frame the prediction was made; NaN where the window runs past the end of the song

surprisal.meaning: mean over the 44 features of the Gaussian NLL (nats) of the prediction made at frame t - 2h + 1, stamped on frame t where its window completes; NaN before frame 2h - 1

arousal.meaning: core_b7 arousal value: one-pole of the L1 + L2 surprisal, rise 1 s, decay 8 s

gain.meaning: 1 + w_g * dev, per layer, for the 2 s block; dev = arousal minus its 60 s running mean read at the block start

exponent.meaning: clamp(1 + w_tau * dev, 0.1, 10) per layer for the 2 s block: the exponent applied to |lambda| of the layer's modes

selfsimilarity.meaning: 1 - max cosine between the current 2,048-d code and the codes stored at least 17 s earlier. Code: a fixed random projection (seed 20261104) of [features pooled over 2 s, layer norm of [Re, Im] of the L3 and L4 modes], L2-normalised, no sparsification; one per 0.5 s; held between ticks; NaN until the first stored code is 17 s old

coherence.meaning: per layer, the magnitude-weighted Kuramoto order parameter |sum h| / sum |h| of the 256 mode phases, per frame, averaged over 1 s windows stepped every 0.1 s

layer_mean_re.meaning: per layer, the mean over its 256 modes of Re h at every frame (100 Hz, not the 30 Hz grid); the trace the viewer draws as the layer's strip

crossings: dropped (BRAIN_SPEC 7.14 point 4): the four coherence traces are the data; braindump_thresholds.json keeps the recorded finding only
names: files use 'self-similarity' and 'cross-band coherence' / 'phase order parameter' only
